Member.name: version
Member.description: Version number

Member.name: publishTimer
Member.description: Expires header value for the PUBLISH request when the device is IMS registered on an LTE network (in seconds).

Member.name: publishExtendedTimer
Member.description: Expires header value for the PUBLISH request when the device is on an eHRPD network(in seconds).

Member.name: publishSrcThrottleTimer
Member.description: Timer in seconds that determines the minimal interval between each PUBLISH request; the device must wait until this timer expires before it sends next PUBLISH request.

Member.name: publishErrRecoveryTimer
Member.description: Publish error recovery timer in seconds.

Member.name: listSubscriptionExpiry
Member.description: Expires header value for the list SUBSCRIBE request when performing capability polling for more than one contact number (in seconds).

Member.name: capabilityCacheExpiry
Member.description: How long (in seconds) cached capability information of a particular contact is still valid before it is updated by Capability Polling

Member.name: availabilityCacheExpiry
Member.description: How long (in seconds) cached availability information of a particular contact is considered still valid before new Availability Fetch need to be sent.

Member.name: capabilityPollInterval
Member.description: Time interval in seconds between each Capability Polling.

Member.name: maxEntriesInListSubscribe
Member.description: Maximum number of contacts that can be included in a list subscribe request.

Member.name: isCapDiscoveryEnabled
Member.description: On and Off value that determines whether capability/availability discovery is enabled (0 – Off, 1 – On).

Member.name: isGzipEnabled
Member.description: Gzip enablerment: 0 - disabled, 1 - enabled.

Member.name: userAgent
Member.description: User Agent

Member.name: lastPublishETag
Member.description: Not used or set by OEM; used internally by the Presence Enabler for persistent storage of the last eTag string in the server's 200 OK response to the PUBLISH request.

Member.name: lastPublishRespTime
Member.description: Not used or set by OEM; used internally by the Presence Enabler for persistent storage of the last time 200OK response to PUBLISH request was received.

Member.name: lastPublishExpiry
Member.description: Not used or set by OEM; used internally by the Presence Enabler for persistent storage of the value of the Expires header in the 200 OK response to last PUBLISH request.
